# Pezu Standard Medics Concern

> Nigeria's premier distributor of certified medical equipment, laboratory diagnostic test kits, and surgical disposable consumables. Based in Idumota, Lagos Island, supplying hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, and healthcare providers nationwide.

## Company Overview
- **Name**: Pezu Standard Medics Concern (also known as Pezu Medics)
- **Primary Location**: 24 Alubomimu Street, off Imaro Street, Idumota, Lagos Island, Lagos State, Nigeria
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 24 Hours
- **Direct Order & WhatsApp Hotline**: +234 810 511 7437
- **Official Email**: pezustandardmedicsconcerns@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://www.pezustandardmedics.com
- **WhatsApp Order Link**: https://wa.me/2348105117437?text=Hello%20Pezu%20Standard%20Medics
- **Business Model**: Wholesale and retail medical supply with same-day Lagos dispatch and rapid interstate courier across Nigeria.

## Core Product Categories & Specializations
1. **Medical & Surgical Consumables & Disposables**:
   - Disposable syringes (1ml, 2ml, 5ml, 10ml, 20ml, 50ml)
   - Surgical and examination gloves (latex, nitrile, sterile powdered and powder-free)
   - Hypodermic needles, scalp vein sets, IV cannulas, infusion sets
   - Surgical sutures, scalpel blades, gauze rolls, cotton wool, surgical drapes, face masks, aprons
2. **Laboratory Diagnostic Products**:
   - Rapid Diagnostic Test (RDT) kits: Malaria P.f/Pan, Hepatitis B & C, HIV 1/2, Typhoid (Widal/rapid), Pregnancy (HCG), Serum Tuberculosis, Syphilis
   - Specimen collection bottles: Lithium Heparin, EDTA, Plain, Fluoride Oxalate, ESR tubes
   - Urine test strips (10-parameter, 4-parameter, glucose/protein)
   - Microscopic slides, cover slips, test tubes, centrifuge tubes, pipette tips
3. **Medical & Diagnostic Equipment**:
   - Clinical centrifuges, autoclaves and steam sterilizers
   - Suction machines, patient monitors, pulse oximeters, digital and aneroid sphygmomanometers
   - Diagnostic ultrasound scanners, ECG machines, microscopes, phototherapy units, surgical operating lamps

## Procurement & Ordering Guidelines
- **Live Inventory Inquiries**: Clients can search the full live catalog on https://www.pezustandardmedics.com and click "Enquire on WhatsApp" for instantaneous invoice generation and order confirmation.
- **Bulk Wholesale & Tenders**: Healthcare administrators and hospital procurement departments can submit request-for-quotes (RFQs) directly via email or WhatsApp.
- **Payment Methods**: Verified Nigerian bank transfers and direct corporate invoicing.
- **Delivery**: Express dispatch within Lagos metropolis; reliable nationwide dispatch via leading logistics hubs across all 36 Nigerian states.
